description: Go after the life you want 🥂#LifeByDesign #fyp #LeadershipVibes #lifehack
transcript: life is not as hard as we make it yes things happen in the external world things happen out of our control we are not robots we are meant to fall but we are also meant to get back up there is nothing in this life that is unattainable there is not a dream that you've had that you cannot reach I know this for sure because I am a dreamer and in turn I've learned how to take action to complement being a dreamer there is nothing that you cannot touch if you want it
